nuggets.text: The Owls play on Sept. 12, the same date JFK gave his 1962 "We choose to go to the Moon" speech at Rice Stadium.
JFK handwrote the line "Why does Rice play Texas?" into his famous 1962 Moon speech at Rice Stadium.
Rice Stadium hosted Super Bowl VIII in 1974, the first Super Bowl ever played in Texas.
Rice Stadium was designed so the entire crowd could empty out in nine minutes.
In the 1954 Cotton Bowl, a helmetless Alabama player came off the sideline to tackle Rice's Dicky Maegle, and the Owls were awarded the TD.
Owls head coach Scott Abell was a catcher drafted by the Kansas City Royals in 1992 before turning to coaching.
The Owls ran the ball 70 times for 465 yards and threw just 10 passes in their 31-3 opener against Houston Christian.
Scott Abell is the eighth Owls coach to win his first two season openers, and the first since Fred Goldsmith in 1989.
Jacurri Brown ran for 98 yards in his Owls debut, while Tyvonn Byars posted his first 100-yard college game.
The Owls and Fighting Irish first met in 1915, and Saturday is only their sixth meeting ever.
